A demo from the docs page "Images" (get_doc(path: "concepts/common-elements/images")). It shows one setting in isolation: for a chart you build, start the themes with `Animated` and `ResponsiveMax`.

## JavaScript

```javascript
/**
 * ---------------------------------------
 * This demo was created using amCharts 5.
 *
 * For more information visit:
 * https://www.amcharts.com/
 *
 * Documentation is available at:
 * https://docs.amcharts.com/v5/
 * ---------------------------------------
 */

// Create root
var root = am5.Root.new("chartdiv");

// Create chart
var chart = root.container.children.push(
  am5.Container.new(root, {
    width: am5.percent(100),
    height: am5.percent(100),
    background: am5.Rectangle.new(root, {
      stroke: am5.color(0x555555)
    })
  })
);

chart.children.push(
  am5.Picture.new(root, {
    width: 100,
    height: 100,
    x: am5.percent(30),
    y: am5.percent(50),
    centerX: am5.percent(50),
    centerY: am5.percent(50),
    src: "https://docs.amcharts.com/assets/icon_btc.svg"
  })
);

chart.children.push(
  am5.Picture.new(root, {
    width: 100,
    height: 100,
    x: am5.percent(70),
    y: am5.percent(50),
    centerX: am5.percent(50),
    centerY: am5.percent(50),
    src: "data:image/svg+xml;base64,"
  })
);
```

## HTML

```html
<div id="chartdiv"></div>
```

## CSS

```css
#chartdiv {
  width: 350px;
  height: 350px;
  margin: auto;
}
```

- https://cdn.amcharts.com/lib/5/index.js
